Non reentrant for the same Network. Parameters (in) Network Handle of the addressed CAN network for the baud rate change Baud Rate Config ID references a baud rate configuration by ID (see Can Controller Baud Rate Config ID) Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK: Service request accepted, setting of (new) baud rate started E_ NOT_ OK: Service request not accepted Description This service shall start an asynchronous process to change the baud rate for the configured CAN controllers of a certain CAN network. Depending on necessary baud rate modifications the controllers might have to reset. Available via Can SM.h
